summary: Triage a 35-issue supplier-quality Jira backlog through the Jira CLI. The agent must read issue JSON/descriptions, edit priority/component/assignee fields, create exactly one directed Duplicates link for each duplicate pair, transition only duplicate issues to Done through the legal workflow, and place the Cycle 7 label exactly on the committed set. No report file is graded; the live Jira mock state is the sole deliverable.
check_strategy: private/expected_answer.json drives deterministic checks; the verifier reads live jira_cli issues and issue_links over MOCK_SITE_URL/__bench/state. Binary pass requires all checks. Checks follow docs/check-granularity.md: plumbing folds into one setup_gate; same-skill trivia batches (priority/component/assignee/distractors) each collapse to one capability check (validated per-item internally, failures listed in reason); duplicate handling is KEPT per-pair because dedup completeness is the task's core graded competency.

checks.description: Jira bench state is reachable and non-empty (plumbing gate).
All scored issues have the correct priority from the policy matrix and regulatory override (collapsed batch).
All scored issues have the correct component inferred from the defect narrative (collapsed batch).
All scored issues are assigned to the component owner (collapsed batch).
Per duplicate pair (8 total): exactly one directed Duplicates link from the duplicate to its canonical AND the duplicate transitioned to Done. Kept per-pair (graded dedup completeness).
Precision guard: no reversed/missing/extra Duplicates links; exactly the duplicate issues are closed; canonical issues stay open.
Near-duplicate distractor issues carry no Duplicates link and remain open (collapsed negative batch).
The Cycle 7 label appears exactly on the capacity/blocker-correct committed set (triage_policy.md §5) and nowhere else among the triage batch.

notes: Total checks = 15: setup_gate + priority_correct + component_correct + assignee_correct + 8x duplicate_handled::<dup> + duplicate_set_integrity + distractors_untouched + cycle_label_correct. Restructured 2026-06-08 from the previous 72-check per-item layout (pure aggregation, no validation loosened) per docs/check-granularity.md. capacity now reflects distinct capability units; dedup completeness stays per-pair as the graded core.
